messages.subject: Pierre | European Mining, Energy & Industrial Executive Profile | ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Hervé-Bazin,

I am sharing my profile for senior European and international leadership mandates across mining, minerals, energy, utilities and industrial businesses.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your work across minerals and mining, energy and utilities, manufacturing and other industrial sectors makes my background relevant to searches where leaders must combine institutional credibility, sustainability, regulatory alignment and cross-functional execution.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my global executive CV for confidential consideration.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
